summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by British American Tobacco p.l.c. reporting a new debt issuance. B.A.T Capital Corporation, a subsidiary, priced $1.5 billion of senior unsecured notes: $750 million 5.300% notes due 2033 and $750 million 5.550% notes due 2036, dated August 3, 2026. The notes are guaranteed on a senior unsecured and joint and several basis by the parent and three affiliates. Underwriters include Citigroup, Deutsche Bank, Goldman Sachs, Santander, and Wells Fargo. This is an ordinary debt offering, not a special situation. No equity transactions, repurchases, or strategic events are present. What to watch: routine debt capital management, no risk-arb angle.
